title: aster hispidus f. albiflorus
intro: Aster hispidus f. albiflorus, commonly known as Chinese Mountain Aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Mountain Aster include its analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms associated with colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
